estilo: 2D fighting game sprite, hand-painted anime style with clean bold outlines, vibrant colors, full body, side view facing right, fighting stance, centered, single character only, no text, no logo, transparent background

kaio.descricao: Kaio, a young Brazilian capoeira fighter, tall and lean, short black curly hair, green and yellow headband, white loose capoeira pants with a yellow cord belt, bare chest, barefoot

yara.descricao: Yara, an agile female fighter inspired by Amazon river legends, long dark braided hair with blue feathers, teal sleeveless martial arts top, dark wrapped pants, water-themed tattoos glowing light blue on her arms

brutus.descricao: Brutus, a huge bald street brawler, thick black beard, red tank top, torn jeans, heavy work boots, steel gauntlets on both fists

poses.parado: idle fighting stance, fists raised, weight balanced
poses.andando: mid-step walking forward in fighting stance
poses.soco: throwing a straight punch forward with the front arm fully extended
poses.chute: high kick forward with the front leg fully extended at head height
poses.pulo: jumping in the air with knees tucked
poses.defesa: blocking with both forearms raised in front of the face
poses.apanhando: recoiling backward after being hit, head snapped back
poses.especial: performing a powerful special move with a glowing energy effect around the fists
